verses.tl: Bismillaahir-Rahmaanir-Raheem
Haa-meem
Tanzeelul-kitaabi mina Allaahil-azeezil-aleem
Ghaafiridh-dhanbi wa qaabilit-tawbi shadeedil-iqaabi dhit-tawli laa ilaaha illaa huwa ilayhil-maseer
Maa yujaadilu fee aayaati Allaahi illal-ladheena kafaroo falaa yaghrurka taqallubuhum fil-bilaad
Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu noohin wal-ahzaabu min ba'dihim wa hammat kullu ummatin birasoolihim liya'khudhoohu wa jaadaloo bil-baatili liyudhidoo bihil-haqqa fa-akhadhtuhum fakayfa kaana iqaab
Wa kadhalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika alal-ladheena kafaroo annahum ashaabun-naar

Al-ladheena yahmiloonal-arsha wa man hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wa yu'minoona bihi wa yastaghfiroona lilladheena aamanoo rabbanaa wasi'ta kulla shay'in rahmatan wa ilman faghfir lilladheena taaboo wattaba'oo sabeelaka wa qihim adhaabal-jaheem
Rabbanaa wa adkhilhum jannaati adnin allatee wa-adtahum wa man salaha min aabaa'ihim wa azwaajihim wa dhurriyyaatihim innaka antal-azeezul-hakeem
Wa qihimus-sayyi'aati wa man taqis-sayyi'aati yawma'idhin faqad rahimtahu wa dhaalika huwal-fawzul-azeem
Innal-ladheena kafaroo yunaadawna lamaqtu Allaahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum idh tud'awna ilal-eemaani fatakfuroon
Qaaloo rabbanaa amattanaa ithnatayni wa ahyaytanaa ithnatayni fa'tarafnaa bidhunoobinaa fahal ilaa khuroojin min sabeel
Dhaalikum bi-annahu idhaa du'iya Allaahu wahdahu kafartum wa in yushrak bihi tu'minoo fal-hukmu Lillaahil-aliyyil-kabeer
Huwal-ladhee yureekum aayaatihi wa yunazzilu lakum minas-samaa'i rizqan wa maa yatadhakkaru illaa man yuneeb
Faad'oo Allaaha mukhliseena lahud-deena wa law karihal-kaafiroon
Rafee'ud-darajaati dhul-arshi yulqir-rooha min amrihi alaa man yashaa'u min ibaadihi liyundhira yawmat-talaaq
Yawma hum baarizoona laa yakhfaa alaa Allaahi minhum shay'un limanil-mulkul-yawma Lillaahil-waahidil-qahhaar
Al-yawma tujzaa kullu nafsin bimaa kasabat laa zulmal-yawma innallaaha saree'ul-hisaab
Wa andhirhum yawmal-aazifati idhil-quloobu ladal-hanaajiri kaazimeena maa liz-zaalimeena min hameemin wa laa shafee'in yutaa
Ya'lamu khaa'inatal-a'yuni wa maa tukhfis-sudoor
Wallaahu yaqdee bil-haqqi wal-ladheena yad'oona min doonihi laa yaqdoona bishay'in innallaaha huwas-samee'ul-baseer

Awa lam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-ladheena kaanoo min qablihim kaanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwatan wa aathaaran fil-ardi fa-akhadhahumu Allaahu bidhunoobihim wa maa kaana lahum mini Allaahi min waaq
Dhaalika bi-annahum kaanat ta'teehim rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati fakafaroo fa-akhadhahumu Allaahu innahu qawiyyun shadeedul-iqaab
Wa laqad arsalnaa moosaa bi-aayaatinaa wa sultaanin mubeen
Ilaa fir'awna wa haamaana wa qaaroona faqaaloo saahirun kadhdhaab
Falammaa jaa'ahum bil-haqqi min indinaa qaaluq-tuloo abnaa'al-ladheena aamanoo ma'ahu wastahyoo nisaa'ahum wa maa kaydul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
Wa qaala fir'awnu dharoonee aqtul moosaa wa lyad'u rabbahu innee akhaafu an yubaddila deenakum aw an yuzhira fil-ardil-fasaad
Wa qaala moosaa innee udhtu birabbee wa rabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin laa yu'minu biyawmil-hisaab

Wa qaala rajulun mu'minun min aali fir'awna yaktumu eemaanahu ataqtuloona rajulan an yaqoola rabbiya Allaahu wa qad jaa'akum bil-bayyinaati min rabbikum wa in yaku kaadhiban fa-alayhi kadhibuhu wa in yaku saadiqan yusibkum ba'dul-ladhee ya'idukum innallaaha laa yahdee man huwa musrifun kadhdhaab
Yaa qawmi lakumul-mulkul-yawma zaahireena fil-ardi faman yansurunaa min ba'si Allaahi in jaa'anaa qaala fir'awnu maa ureekum illaa maa araa wa maa ahdeekum illaa sabeelar-rashaad
Wa qaalal-ladhee aamana yaa qawmi innee akhaafu alaykum mithla yawmil-ahzaab
Mithla da'bi qawmi noohin wa aadin wa thamooda wal-ladheena min ba'dihim wa maa Allaahu yureedu zulman lil-ibaad
Wa yaaqawmi innee akhaafu alaykum yawmat-tanaad
Yawma tuwalloona mudbireena maa lakum mina Allaahi min aasimin wa man yudlili Allaahu famaa lahu min haad

Wa laqad jaa'akum yoosufu min qablu bil-bayyinaati famaa ziltum fee shakkin mimmaa jaa'akum bihi hattaa idhaa halaka qultum lan yab'atha Allaahu min ba'dihi rasoolan kadhaalika yudillu Allaahu man huwa musrifun murtaab
Al-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaati Allaahi bighayri sultaanin ataahum kabura maqtan indallaahi wa indal-ladheena aamanoo kadhaalika yatba'u Allaahu alaa kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbaar
Wa qaala fir'awnu yaa haamaanu ibni lee sarhan la-allee ablughul-asbaab
Asbaabas-samaawaati fa-attali'a ilaa ilaahi moosaa wa innee la-azunnuhu kaadhiban wa kadhalika zuyyina lifir'awna soo'u amalihi wa sudda anis-sabeeli wa maa kaydu fir'awna illaa fee tabaab
Wa qaalal-ladhee aamana yaa qawmi ittabi'oonee ahdikum sabeelar-rashaad
Yaa qawmi innamaa haadhihil-hayaa utud-dunyaa mataa'un wa innal-aakhirata hiya daarul-qaraar
Man amila sayyi'atan falaa yujzaa illaa mithlahaa wa man amila saalihan min dhakarin aw unthaa wa huwa mu'minun fa-ulaa'ika yadkhuloonal-jannata yurzaqoona feehaa bighayri hisaab
Wa yaaqawmi maa lee ad'ookum ilan-najaati wa tad'oonanee ilan-naar
Tad'oonanee li'kfura Billaahi wa ushrika bihi maa laysa lee bihi ilmun wa anaa ad'ookum ilal-azeezil-ghaffaar
Laa jarama annamaa tad'oonanee ilayhi laysa lahu da'watun fid-dunyaa wa laa fil-aakhirati wa anna maraddanaa ilaa Allaahi wa annal-musrifeena hum ashaabun-naar
Fasatadhkuroona maa aqoolu lakum wa ufawwidu amree ilaa Allaahi innallaaha baseerun bil-ibaad
Fawaqaahu Allaahu sayyi'aati maa makaroo wa haaqa bi-aali fir'awna soo'ul-adhaab
An-naaru yu'radoona alayhaa ghuduwwan wa ashiyyan wa yawma taqoomus-saa'atu adkhiloo aala fir'awna ashaddal-adhaab
Wa idh yatahaajjoona fin-naari fayaqoolud-du'afaa'u lilladheena istakbaroo innaa kunnaa lakum taba'an fahal antum mughnoona annaa naseeban minan-naar
Qaalal-ladheena istakbaroo innaa kullun feehaa innallaaha qad hakama baynal-ibaad
Wa qaalal-ladheena fin-naari likhazanati jahannama ud'oo rabbakum yukhaffif annaa yawman minal-adhaab
Qaaloo awa lam taku ta'teekum rusulukum bil-bayyinaati qaaloo balaa qaaloo faad'oo wa maa du'aa'ul-kaafireena illaa fee dalaal
Innaa lanansuru rusulanaa wal-ladheena aamanoo fil-hayaatid-dunyaa wa yawma yaqoomul-ashhaad
Yawma laa yanfa'uz-zaalimeena ma'dhiratuhum wa lahumul-la'natu wa lahum soo'ud-daar
Wa laqad aataynaa moosal-hudaa wa awrathnaa banee israa'eelal-kitaab
Hudan wa dhikraa li'wlil-albaab
Fasbir inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun wastaghfir lidhanbika wa sabbih bihamdi rabbika bil-ashiyyi wal-ibkaar
Innal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaati Allaahi bighayri sultaanin ataahum in fee sudoorihim illaa kibrun maa hum bibaaligheehi fasta'idh Billaahi innahu huwas-samee'ul-baseer
Lakhalqus-samaawaati wal-ardi akbaru min khalqin-naasi wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa ya'lamoon
Wa maa yastawil-a'maa wal-baseeru wal-ladheena aamanoo wa amilus-saalihaati wa lal-musee'u qaleelan maa tatadhakkaroon
Innas-saa'ata la-aatiyatun laa rayba feehaa wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa yu'minoon
Wa qaala rabbukum ud'oonee astajib lakum innal-ladheena yastakbiroona an ibaadatee sayadkhuloona jahannama daakhireen
Allaahul-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-layla litaskunoo feehi wan-nahaara mubsiran innallaaha ladhoo fadlin alan-naasi wa laakinna aktharan-naasi laa yashkuroon
Dhalikumu Allaahu rabbukum khaaliqu kulli shay'in laa ilaaha illaa huwa fa-annaa tu'ufakoon
Kadhaalika yu'ufakul-ladheena kaanoo bi-aayaati Allaahi yajhadoon
Allaahul-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-arda qaraaran was-samaa'a binaa'an wa sawwarakum fa-ahsana suwarakum wa razaqakum minat-tayyibaati dhalikumu Allaahu rabbukum fatabaaraka Allaahu rabbul-aalameen
Huwal-hayyu laa ilaaha illaa huwa faad'oohu mukhliseena lahud-deenal-hamdu Lillaahi rabbil-aalameen
Qul innee nuheetu an a'budal-ladheena tad'oona min doonillaahi lammaa jaa'aniyal-bayyinaatu min rabbee wa umirtu an uslima lirabbil-aalameen

Huwal-ladhee khalaqakum min turaabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min alaqatin thumma yukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum thumma litakoonoo shuyookhan wa minkum man yutawaffaa min qablu wa litablughoo ajalan musamman wa la-allakum ta'qiloon
Huwal-ladhee yuhyee wa yumeetu fa-idhaa qadaa amran fa-innamaa yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoon
Alam taraa ilal-ladheena yujaadiloona fee aayaati Allaahi annaa yusrafoon
Al-ladheena kadhdhaboo bil-kitaabi wa bimaa arsalnaa bihi rusulanaa fasawfa ya'lamoon
Idhil-aghlaalu fee a'naaqihim was-salaasilu yushaboon
Fil-hameemi thumma fin-naari yusjaroon
Thumma qeela lahum ayna maa kuntum tushrikoon
Min doonillaahi qaaloo dalloo annaa bal lam nakun nad'oo min qablu shay'an kadhaalika yudillu Allaahul-kaafireen
Dhaalikum bimaa kuntum tafrahoona fil-ardi bighayril-haqqi wa bimaa kuntum tamrahoon
Udkhuloo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feehaa fabi'sa mathwal-mutakabbireen
Fasbir inna wa'da Allaahi haqqun fa-immaa nuriyannaka ba'dal-ladhee na'iduhum aw natawaffayannaka fa-ilaynaa yurja'oon

Wa laqad arsalnaa rusulan min qablika minhum man qasasnaa alayka wa minhum man lam naqsus alayka wa maa kaana lirasoolin an ya'tiya bi-aayatin illaa bi-idhni Allaahi fa-idhaa jaa'a amru Allaahi qudiya bil-haqqi wa khasira hunaalikal-mubtiloon
Allaahul-ladhee ja'ala lakumul-an'aam litarkaboo minhaa wa minhaa ta'kuloon
Wa lakum feehaa manaafi'u wa litablughoo alayhaa haajatan fee sudoorikum wa alayhaa wa alal-fulki tuhmaloon
Wa yureekum aayaatihi fa-ayya aayaati Allaahi tunkiroon
Afalam yaseeroo fil-ardi fayanzuroo kayfa kaana aaqibatul-ladheena min qablihim kaanoo akthara minhum wa ashadda quwwatan wa aathaaran fil-ardi famaa aghnaa anhum maa kaanoo yaksiboon
Falammaa jaa'athum rusuluhum bil-bayyinaati farihoo bimaa indahum minal-ilmi wa haaqa bihim maa kaanoo bihi yastahzi'oon
Falammaa ra'aw ba'sanaa qaaloo aamannaa Billaahi wahdahu wa kafarnaa bimaa kunnaa bihi mushrikeen
Falam yaku yanfa'uhum eemaanuhum lammaa ra'aw ba'sanaa sunnata Allaahil-latee qad khalat fee ibaadihi wa khasira hunaalikal-kaafiroon
